test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT in relation to Non - Profit Organisations Accounts?

options.text: Receipt and Payment Account follows Nominal Account rules.
Receipt and Payment Account is similar to cash book.
All cash payments both capital and revenue during the period are credited to Receipt and Payment Account.
No provisions are recorded in Receipt and Payment Account.

solution:
The correct answer is** Receipt and Payment Account follows Nominal Account rules.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Receipt and Payment Account follows Nominal Account rules:**

 
 
• This statement is incorrect. The Receipt and Payment Account is a real account, not a nominal account. It records all cash and bank transactions related to receipts and payments, regardless of their nature (capital or revenue).
 
• Nominal accounts, on the other hand, deal with incomes, expenses, gains, and losses, which are not directly recorded in the Receipt and Payment Account.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Receipt and Payment Account is similar to cash book:**

 
 
• This statement is correct. The Receipt and Payment Account is similar to a cash book as it records all cash and bank transactions during an accounting period. It shows the opening balance, receipts, payments, and closing balance of cash and bank accounts.
 
 
 
• **All cash payments both capital and revenue during the period are credited to Receipt and Payment Account:**
 
 
• This statement is correct. The Receipt and Payment Account captures all cash payments made during the period, whether they are of a capital or revenue nature, on the credit side.
 
 
 
• **No provisions are recorded in Receipt and Payment Account:**
 
 
• This statement is correct. Provisions, which are non-cash items, are not recorded in the Receipt and Payment Account. This account only captures actual cash and bank transactions.
